title: TARSActionRequest
description: Canonical request to execute a Windows-wide TARS skill action (Wave 2A). Emitted by the HUD, global hotkey/voice path, or a deterministic command router; consumed by the action runtime/permission engine and the target skill. Shared by the backend, the action runtime, and the native shell/HUD.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Bump on any breaking change and record a new ADR in DECISIONS.md.

id.description: Unique identifier for this request. ActionResult.request_id correlates back to this value.

arguments.description: Action-specific arguments. Structure is defined by the target skill, not by this contract; the skill's own validate() is the source of truth for what is acceptable.

source.description: What originated this request. 'deterministic' marks a request resolved by deterministic command routing rather than an LLM (see AGENTS.md non-negotiable: deterministic commands bypass the LLM when possible).

active_context.description: Snapshot of the foreground window at request time, if known. No screenshot/content capture in Wave 2A -- process/title/bounds only.

requested_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this request was created.

executable.description: Foreground process executable name (e.g. 'notepad.exe'), not a full path.

window_bounds.description: Screen-space bounding rectangle of the foreground window, if available.
